mapper.sql: id, user_id, family_id, token_hash, created_at, last_used_at, absolute_expires_at, idle_expires_at, revoked_at, revoked_reason, replaced_by_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refresh_sessions (user_id, family_id, token_hash, absolute_expires_at, idle_expires_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{familyId}::uuid, #{tokenHash}, #{absoluteExpiresAt}, #{idleExpiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM refresh_sessions WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE refresh_sessions SET revoked_at = #{usedAt}, revoked_reason = 'rotated', last_used_at = #{usedAt}, replaced_by_id = #{replacedById} WHERE id = #{id} AND revoked_at IS NULL
UPDATE refresh_sessions SET revoked_at = #{revokedAt}, revoked_reason = #{reason} WHERE family_id = #{familyId}::uuid AND revoked_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT family_id, min(created_at) AS created_at, max(last_used_at) AS last_used_at, min(idle_expires_at) FILTER (WHERE revoked_at IS NULL AND idle_expires_at > now() AND absolute_expires_at > now()) AS idle_expires_at, min(absolute_expires_at) FILTER (WHERE revoked_at IS NULL AND idle_expires_at > now() AND absolute_expires_at > now()) AS absolute_expires_at FROM refresh_sessions WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY family_id HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE revoked_at IS NULL AND idle_expires_at > now() AND absolute_expires_at > now()) > 0 ORDER BY coalesce(max(last_used_at), min(created_at)) DESC, family_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(DISTINCT family_id) FROM refresh_sessions WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND idle_expires_at > now() AND absolute_expires_at > now()
